newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS - Quarterly burst in Morris volume.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS - Quarterly burst in Morris volume.

text.p: As if like clockwork, options volume on Philip Morris Cos Inc spikes every three months or so the day before the stock goes ex-dividend.
Wednesday was no exception as Philip Morris calls were the eight most active calls at the American Stock Exchange.
Volume was led by the March 120 call, which traded nearly 18,300 contracts by about 1400 CST/2000 GMT.
The March 100 call traded 12,810 and the March 125 call traded 11,985, rounding out the top three.
Underlying shares of Philip Morris were down 2-3/8 at 137-1/4 in heavy trading.
Other busy Philip Morris options included the March 85, 90 adn 95 calls as well as the March 105, 110 and 115 calls.
"I would say it's totally consistent with spreading," Michael Schwartz, a managing director at Oppenheimer & Co, said of the Philip Morris call volume.
"I would say the guy is spreading the 100's, 120's and 125's," he said. "It's all dividend-related, no question."
Philip Morris goes ex-dividend Thursday for a dividend due on April 10.
Investors often use options as a way of capturing the dividend and some traders see dividend-related volume as just a false boost.
One trader said dividend-related options activity on Philip Morris is among the heaviest of all stocks with options.
In other dealings, options on Office Depot Inc remained active as investors continued to speculate on whether its proposed merger with Staples Inc would go through.

On Monday, the U.S. Federal Trade Commission weighed in against the proposed merger, but said Wednesday it was willing to speak with Office Depot, Staples and another competitor, OfficeMax Inc, about the merger and a divestiture deal.
The three companies announced a deal Wednesday under which OfficeMax would buy 28 Office Depot stores and 35 Staples stores.
Traders said options investors were playing all sides.
"We're doing everything," the head of an options trading department in Chicago said. "We've had call buyers and put buyers and sellers all over the place."
"It's just very active," he said. He was referring specifically to action in Office Depot options.
